segments.an3.183-352:1.3: Suññato samādhi, animitto samādhi, appaṇihito samādhi – rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.()[(rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā. katame tayo? savitakkasavicāro samādhi, avitakkavicāramatto samādhi, avitakkaavicāro samādhi. rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.) etthantare pāṭho katthaci dissati, aṭṭhakathāyaṃ passitabbo]
segments.an3.183-352:2.1: “Rāgassa, bhikkhave, pariññāya … pe … parikkhayāya … pahānāya … khayāya … vayāya … virāgāya … nirodhāya … cāgāya … paṭinissaggāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
segments.an3.183-352:3.1: “Dosassa … mohassa … kodhassa … upanāhassa … makkhassa … palāsassa … issāya … macchariyassa … māyāya … sāṭheyyassa … thambhassa … sārambhassa … mānassa … atimānassa … madassa … pamādassa abhiññāya … pariññāya … parikkhayāya … pahānāya … khayāya … vayāya … virāgāya … nirodhāya … cāgāya … paṭinissaggāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
segments.an3.183-352:4.1: (Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.)[() etthantare pāṭho syā. kaṃ. ka. potthakesu na dissati]
segments.an3.183-352:5.1: [imā uddānagāthāyo sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu na dissanti] Rāgaṃ dosañca mohañca, kodhūpanāhapañcamaṃ;
segments.an3.183-352:8.1: Suññato animitto ca, appaṇihito ca tayo;
